findings.title: No security response headers on any page
findings.description: curl -I against the live homepage shows no Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, or Content-Security-Policy headers. GitHub Pages cannot serve custom headers natively.
findings.recommendation: Deploy cloudflare-security-headers-worker.js (drafted and committed at repo root) via Cloudflare dashboard - Workers & Pages, routed to drosamajuma.com/*.

findings.title: No live Google Search Console / CrUX / GA4 data configured
findings.description: No OAuth token or service account configured this session; Unlighthouse extension wrapper also fails on this Windows environment (npx subprocess resolution bug).
findings.recommendation: Set up Google API credentials to unlock real indexation status and field Core Web Vitals data.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: 37 English + 37 Arabic pages under /insights/ (36 articles + hub each), covering IEP, autism, ADHD, teacher training, family guidance, GCC countries, disability-specific guides, and 5 self-authored research pieces
Strong E-E-A-T: named credentialed author (PhD, University of Jordan), consistent Person schema via canonical @id, citations to UN/UNESCO/UNICEF/WHO/Jordanian-government sources on 20+ articles
Every article carries a clear non-clinical disclaimer
0 duplicate content detected across 96 pages

findings.title: 31 of 36 English articles under 300 words (median 255)
findings.description: Both language versions follow a compact 3-section, 2-paragraph template by design; Arabic median is even lower at 197 words. Not thin in the spam-policy sense (genuine expert content, real citations), but likely limits ranking depth and AI-citation surface area.
findings.recommendation: Editorial pass to add a 4th section or more practical detail per article. Do not bulk-expand with AI filler - that trades a real gap for a spam-policy risk.

findings.title: No case studies or testimonials
findings.description: The site has zero client-facing proof-of-outcome content.
findings.recommendation: Produce 2-3 anonymized case studies once client permission is obtained. Cannot be fabricated.

findings.title: No downloadable practical asset
findings.description: No real downloadable tool (e.g., IEP goal-writing template) exists.
findings.recommendation: Build a flagship downloadable IEP template/checklist, available in both languages.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: 0 duplicate titles, 0 duplicate meta descriptions across 96 pages
Exactly 1 H1 per page, 96/96
34 English article titles shortened this session from 61-105 chars down to <=60 chars for SERP display
Insights hub links to all 36 articles (0 orphans); homepage reaches every core page + hub in 1 click

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Person, ProfilePage, Article, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage, CollectionPage all present as valid, parseable JSON-LD (0 parse errors across 96 pages)
Cross-referenced via @id with a single canonical Person node (referenced, not duplicated, across all English pages)
Article citation arrays present and verbatim-preserved on all research-backed articles

findings.title: English homepage was missing FAQPage schema
findings.description: The Arabic homepage had FAQPage JSON-LD matching its visible FAQ section; the English homepage had the identical visible FAQ content (already translated) but no matching schema.
findings.recommendation: Fixed this session - added FAQPage JSON-LD to docs/en/index.html matching the Arabic version's shape.

findings.title: Both CV pages missing Twitter Card meta
findings.description: docs/cv/index.html and docs/en/cv/index.html were the only 2 of 96 pages missing twitter:card/twitter:title/twitter:description/twitter:image.
findings.recommendation: Fixed this session - added matching Twitter Card tags to both pages.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: JS deferred/async, no known render-blocking scripts
Fully static HTML architecture likely performs well but is unmeasured this session

findings.title: No field CWV data available
findings.description: No CrUX/PageSpeed API configured. Unlighthouse extension's wrapper script (unlighthouse_run.py) fails on this Windows environment with a WinError 2 (npx subprocess resolution issue), so no lab data either this session.
findings.recommendation: Configure Google API credentials to get real field data, or fix/replace the Unlighthouse wrapper for Windows.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Fully static HTML with zero JS dependency - the single biggest AI-crawler-friendliness factor
robots.txt allows all crawlers including AI bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, etc.) - business choice, not a defect

findings.title: llms.txt was Arabic-only
findings.description: The entire 48-page English site (added across 8 commits this session) was invisible to AI agents relying on llms.txt for site discovery.
findings.recommendation: Fixed this session - added a full English section to docs/llms.txt with links to all core English pages and the article index.
